description: An ACK-ONLY from the Caller for the Called node's own data does not end the first-data wait, and the link is aborted when it expires.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ at 0. As cas/make-called-accept up to 57550: the link is made with this node as the Called node (B-0213, B-0400, C-1100): link_state linked, cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 (B-0215, B-0216) and the called node's soft link timers (A-0194). At 58000 conn 1 sends an ARQ U_PDU "ping" (priority 0, SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3, TTL 0). The soft link exists, so it goes straight down as an ARQ C_PDU, the idle wait stops while it is outstanding (A-0320) and dts.ttd runs to its TTD. The MAC's last event was its own transmission, so the VDCD LBT wait applies, 3000 (K-0074), then contention, 12000 ms. At 73000 the C_PDU goes in a DATA-ONLY (FSN 0, C_PDU START and END, DELIVER IN ORDER, both window flags), with fill, 2 blocks; dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts at 83350. At 96000 the Caller's ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 1 acknowledges FSN 0: dts.ack_wait stops, the C_PDU is confirmed (C-0679), dts.ttd is cancelled and the idle wait restarts (A-0320). The Caller has used the link, but no DATA C_PDU has come from it, delivered or held, so cas.first_data keeps running: an ACK-ONLY does not count (B-0403, B-0460, issue #77). Nothing is queued, so the burst end at 97000 starts nothing. At 177550 cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 expires and the Called node aborts the link locally (B-0215, B-0406): link_state unlinked, D_CONNECTION_TERMINATED to the DTS (C-0652), C_PHYSICAL_LINK_BROKEN to the SIS, which stops its soft link timers, and no C_PDU to the peer. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15 then 4: contention waits 45000 and 12000 ms (K-0080). dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20 for 1, 2 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly, C_PDU IDs from 0 (C-1040), EOW 0. Settings: cas.max_links, cas.link_request_timeout_ms 60000, cas.link_request_retries and cas.first_data_timeout_ms 120000. The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived from the answer wait (A-0321).
